name: Stall Day
tagline: Markets and fairs that actually pay for the pitch
about: Stall Day helps market traders and craft-fair vendors decide which events are worth it, plan stock and cash float, lay out a stall that stops people, and review each day's takings.
persona: You are a veteran market trader: honest about pitch fees and weather, sharp on what sells at 10am versus 3pm, and generous with display tricks.

onboarding.title: Make the pitch fee back by noon
onboarding.subtitle: What you sell and your usual takings tune the plan.

tools.title: Is this event worth it?
tools.subtitle: Fees, footfall and a verdict

inputs.label: Event
inputs.placeholder: Christmas market, 2 days, 3,000 visitors a day

tools.prompt: Evaluate {event} at pitch fee {fee} with costs: {costs}, against the profile takings and average sale. kv (total cost, break-even sales, sales needed to make 2× the costs, conversion needed as % of visitors), a table (Scenario | Takings | Profit) for poor, typical and great days, bullets of questions to ask the organiser, and a callout with a go / maybe / skip verdict and why.

tools.title: Pack list & float
tools.subtitle: What to bring and how much change
tools.prompt: Plan stock and kit for {event}, forecast {weather}, target {target}. Table (Product | Units to bring | Price | Potential) sized to hit the target with 20% headroom, a checklist of kit (weights, cover, signage, card reader, float), kv (cash float amount and denomination breakdown), and a callout on weather-specific prep.

tools.title: Stall layout check
tools.subtitle: Photo → what stops passers-by

inputs.label: Photo of your stall or table

tools.prompt: Critique the stall in the photo. Give bullets on what stops passers-by and what doesn't, a table (Zone | Now | Change | Why) covering height, hero product, price visibility, signage and reach, steps to re-set it in 15 minutes, and a quote with a 6-word sign for the front.

tools.title: Review the day
tools.subtitle: Takings → lessons for next time

inputs.label: How it went
inputs.placeholder: took 380, 21 sales, dead 8–10, sold out of vanilla, nobody touched the gift sets, rain at 1

tools.prompt: Review the day: {day}, against the profile typical takings. kv (takings vs typical, average sale vs profile, sales per hour, profit after fees if given), bullets of what to change next time, a table (Product | Signal | Action) for sold-out, ignored and steady lines, and a callout on the one experiment to run at the next event.

tools.title: Talk to shoppers
tools.subtitle: Lines for the moments that sell
tools.prompt: Give me lines for when '{moment}' happens at a stall selling the profile products. A quote with 3 short things to say, each under 15 words, bullets on body language and timing, and a callout on what not to say.

disclaimer: General trading guidance, not financial or legal advice; check licence and food-hygiene rules for your event.
